operations.old:
KEEP Action/V/S/F/base 17 RP, range 120 feet, instantaneous reading, and all past and present magical effects in an area. NEW DI7-only three-dimensional grid completion: use actual world coordinates in feet on the existing 5-foot grid. For points A and B, define D(A,B) = max(abs(Ax−Bx), abs(Ay−By), abs(Az−Bz)). This preserves the existing horizontal diagonal metric and explicitly extends it to vertical and combined-axis separation. Choose one actually perceived point C with D(caster’s actual casting position,C) ≤ 120 and actual line of effect before commitment. Record C as a fixed world-space point; do not snap, round or relocate it to obtain eligibility.

At effect resolution, the 20-foot-radius grid-metric sphere includes exactly those spatial cells whose centers P satisfy D(C,P) ≤ 20. Boundary equality is included. This is a sphere under the specified game metric, not a Euclidean ball; impose no additional Euclidean-radius test. Cell inclusion establishes only spatial membership. Current center-to-portion line of effect and solid total cover still clip the actual readable portions, and the existing no-corner-cutting restriction is not bypassed by diagonal distance. Do not disclose a whole footprint merely because one included cell intersects it. A readable historical location need not contain a creature, object or active effect now.

NEW resolution checkpoint: immediately before producing the snapshot, revalidate that the same recorded C remains actually perceived, within D ≤ 120 of the caster’s current actual casting position, and in current caster-to-center line of effect. A legally displaced caster does not move C. If any of those requirements fails, the committed cast produces no information and no refund, substitute center or deferred resolution. An intervening spatial failure that has genuinely ended before this checkpoint does not itself create a continuous-range failure; any independently applicable casting interruption still governs. This adds no second payment, component performance or casting event.

When the center passes, evaluate the readable spatial portions and their history at that resolution checkpoint. This is a spatial-history query of those actual readable places, not a remote view through today’s walls; a presently open portion can still reveal its established earlier local history even if the ancient layout differed. These metric and checkpoint completions govern this Supreme Sight procedure only, not other spells, movement, mounts or general combat geometry.

Privately receive every actual established magical-effect occurrence whose historical footprint intersected those readable spatial portions while the event existed, plus current readable magic there. There is no arbitrary lookback age, rank or record-count ceiling. An ended/destroyed effect remains eligible as history, including one that ended long ago; destruction does not recreate a present object or resource. The Director's actual established history is sufficient without a previously implemented event log, but absence of historical evidence is not proof of no ancient magic. NEW interval representation: one continuing unchanged effect is one interval with its genuinely known transitions, not a generated casting every second. A moving effect has its real local visits/intervals, not a new spell per tile; overlaps retain separate original effect identities.

For each readable occurrence give its actual spell/effect identity, or its established bounded category when no named identity is supplied; generating school/rank only when its source actually defines those fields; readable local footprint; time/relative ordering at its real established precision; and starts, persistence, changes, suppression and endings there. Actual magical nonspell class/item effects and existing dormant enchantments can qualify through their real magic/history, without inventing rank 0 or a school. A record that was never magical is not made magical by nearby events. An effect currently elsewhere has only its local historical footprint here, not a disclosed current remote destination.

This does not automatically reveal a caster's personal identity, private memory, current pool, attunement, full blueprint, upstream origin or unrelated history. Those require their own actual readable manifestation/source permission. Apply each genuine present/historical information defense to the facts and time intervals it really covers: a current-only ward does not retroactively erase unrelated old history; an express historical-trace protection still applies. Do not disclose protected existence through count, placeholders, missing sequence numbers or conspicuous gaps. Undefined precision stays uncertain rather than being rounded into an invented date. Supply all independently useful readable information, not only public facts or a single trace.

The snapshot can be remembered/recorded through ordinary time and tools. It grants no ongoing sensory feed, targeting sight, time travel, replay, dispel, reconstruction, spell acquisition or Fate Echo observation receipt. Learning a cast's past existence now is not directly witnessing that original cast in its original time window. Equivalent unchanged paid inquiries return consistent overlapping records; genuine new events/protection/evidence can change them. No spent material, soul, class permission or cosmological origin is recovered or interpreted.

operations.old:
KEEP Action/V/S/F/base 17 RP, range 120 feet, instantaneous reading, and all past and present magical effects in an area. NEW DI7-only three-dimensional grid completion: use actual world coordinates in feet on the existing 5-foot grid. For points A and B, define D(A,B) = max(abs(Ax−Bx), abs(Ay−By), abs(Az−Bz)). This preserves the existing horizontal diagonal metric and explicitly extends it to vertical and combined-axis separation. Choose one actually perceived point C with D(caster’s actual casting position,C) ≤ 120 and actual line of effect before commitment. Record C as a fixed world-space point; do not snap, round or relocate it to obtain eligibility.

At effect resolution, the 20-foot-radius grid-metric sphere includes exactly those spatial cells whose centers P satisfy D(C,P) ≤ 20. Boundary equality is included. This is a sphere under the specified game metric, not a Euclidean ball; impose no additional Euclidean-radius test. Cell inclusion establishes only spatial membership. Current center-to-portion line of effect and solid total cover still clip the actual readable portions, and the existing no-corner-cutting restriction is not bypassed by diagonal distance. Do not disclose a whole footprint merely because one included cell intersects it. A readable historical location need not contain a creature, object or active effect now.

NEW resolution checkpoint: immediately before producing the snapshot, revalidate that the same recorded C remains actually perceived, within D ≤ 120 of the caster’s current actual casting position, and in current caster-to-center line of effect. A legally displaced caster does not move C. If any of those requirements fails, the committed cast produces no information and no refund, substitute center or deferred resolution. An intervening spatial failure that has genuinely ended before this checkpoint does not itself create a continuous-range failure; any independently applicable casting interruption still governs. This adds no second payment, component performance or casting event.

When the center passes, evaluate the readable spatial portions and their history at that resolution checkpoint. This is a spatial-history query of those actual readable places, not a remote view through today’s walls; a presently open portion can still reveal its established earlier local history even if the ancient layout differed. These metric and checkpoint completions govern this Supreme Sight procedure only, not other spells, movement, mounts or general combat geometry.

Privately receive every actual established magical-effect occurrence whose historical footprint intersected those readable spatial portions while the event existed, plus current readable magic there. There is no arbitrary lookback age, rank or record-count ceiling. An ended/destroyed effect remains eligible as history, including one that ended long ago; destruction does not recreate a present object or resource. The Director's actual established history is sufficient without a previously implemented event log, but absence of historical evidence is not proof of no ancient magic. NEW interval representation: one continuing unchanged effect is one interval with its genuinely known transitions, not a generated casting every second. A moving effect has its real local visits/intervals, not a new spell per tile; overlaps retain separate original effect identities.

For each readable occurrence give its actual spell/effect identity, or its established bounded category when no named identity is supplied; generating school/rank only when its source actually defines those fields; readable local footprint; time/relative ordering at its real established precision; and starts, persistence, changes, suppression and endings there. Actual magical nonspell class/item effects and existing dormant enchantments can qualify through their real magic/history, without inventing rank 0 or a school. A record that was never magical is not made magical by nearby events. An effect currently elsewhere has only its local historical footprint here, not a disclosed current remote destination.

This does not automatically reveal a caster's personal identity, private memory, current pool, attunement, full blueprint, upstream origin or unrelated history. Those require their own actual readable manifestation/source permission. Apply each genuine present/historical information defense to the facts and time intervals it really covers: a current-only ward does not retroactively erase unrelated old history; an express historical-trace protection still applies. Do not disclose protected existence through count, placeholders, missing sequence numbers or conspicuous gaps. Undefined precision stays uncertain rather than being rounded into an invented date. Supply all independently useful readable information, not only public facts or a single trace.

The snapshot can be remembered/recorded through ordinary time and tools. It grants no ongoing sensory feed, targeting sight, time travel, replay, dispel, reconstruction, spell acquisition or Fate Echo observation receipt. Learning a cast's past existence now is not directly witnessing that original cast in its original time window. Equivalent unchanged paid inquiries return consistent overlapping records; genuine new events/protection/evidence can change them. No spent material, soul, class permission or cosmological origin is recovered or interpreted.
